description: Source file containing utility functions for telemetry, including memory management, device property retrieval, and comparison functions, specific to the 't2common' module.

methods.name: freeParam
methods.description: Frees memory allocated for a Param structure and its string members.

methods.name: freeStaticParam
methods.description: Frees memory allocated for a StaticParam structure and its string members.

methods.name: freeEMarker
methods.description: Frees memory associated with an EventMarker structure, including nested members and vectors.

methods.name: freeAccumulatedParam
methods.description: Frees memory for accumulated parameter data.

methods.name: freeGMarker
methods.description: Frees memory associated with a GrepMarker structure and its members.

methods.name: compareLogFileNames
methods.description: Comparator function for sorting GrepMarker pointers by logFile name.

methods.name: freeTriggerCondition
methods.description: Frees memory for a TriggerCondition structure and its string members.

methods.name: getDevicePropertyData
methods.description: Reads a device property value from a file and stores it in provided buffer.
